# D0 Walk-Forward Evaluation

D0 was evaluated with the same expanding folds, approved data, capital reset, eligibility, LIMIT/IOC, one-tick, fee, VAT, valuation, and no-lookahead protocol as Design A/C.

Classification: **MIXED** — D0 materially reduces turnover and transaction cost, but remains loss-making and lacks stable positive OOS evidence.
